Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1075115. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, and join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Filter by standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id.
